irregularities.what: The session prompt contains two incompatible 'current high score' claims: 0.3195 (DARD, public #1) and 0.4413 ('current competition leaderboard GEMSDOE high score'). The digits 0.4413 coincide EXACTLY with GEMSDOE32 IR-33-LM-01, where 0.4413 was a drift-model artifact for a pruned variant (1.35x the then-leader, refuted by the live record) — not a leaderboard row. Either (a) a team genuinely reached 0.4413 (extraordinary: +38% over 0.3195), or (b) the prompt line misquotes the instrument artifact as a leaderboard score. Sandbox egress blocks drivendata.org, so this repo verified NEITHER. Lane-82 work targets beating the verified group-best chain (0.2778) and is unaffected by this ambiguity, but any 'we are #N on the board' claim must wait for a dated leaderboard snapshot. UPDATE 2026-10-21 merge: a sibling session in this repo reports reading the live leaderboard on 2026-10-21 with the earlier/higher figure (0.4413) on top (their IR-82-04). Adopted as second-source confirmation; 0.3195 treated as stale. The 0.4413-vs-LM-artifact digit coincidence remains unexplained.

No organizer receipt links ANY group file's bytes to ANY leaderboard row (same finding as GEMSDOE32 IR-32-SCORE-01). All score attributions (0.2600/0.2708/0.2778 chain, 0.3195 DARD) are OWNER-REPORTED. The live-anchored inversion (T=5069, K~13300) is CONDITIONAL on the chain's attribution being correct. The pixel-exact prune chain (D2.8 -> R1 -> B2) is byte-verified; the SCORES attached to it are not.

Gate v1.0 compared candidate SGMC-FAR quadrants against hand-copied SGMC-RAW quadrant constants (wrong instrument), falsely failing R2 (1/4 instead of 4/4). Fixed by evaluating the base mask in-process. Regression coverage: tests/test_gate.py pins in-process base quadrants to the receipt.

SGMC-proxy truth covers only PART of the live hidden truth and rewards scarp-chasing (SGMC faults are surface-expressed by construction): a fresh h82_1 emission scores SGMC-FAR 0.1403 yet CAT-HIDDEN 0.0030 (~random). SGMC-FAR is therefore licensed ONLY for flank surgery on a fixed carrier + small screened additions — never for wholesale emission replacement. The historical lane candidate used this proxy within its declared lane, but its results are noncanonical and it is not authorized for submission.

The 19-band training_features.tif was never fetched (418 MB; only available login-walled or as owner-mirror parts). Lane 82 uses ONLY the sha256-pinned external u8 stacks + GDR tables + catalogue grids. Any detector needing the official 19 bands (e.g. MT conductivity, InSAR) is out of scope for this lane.

The H82-2 lane-local research gate is not a selector decision.
